meta.title: Daedalus Studio — Make changes. Keep control.
meta.description: Daedalus Studio is a workspace for agents that understand context, take action, and prove the result.

hero.title:
Make changes.
Keep control.
hero.description: Daedalus Studio is a workspace for agents that understand context, take action, and prove the result.
hero.caption: DESCRIBE → PLAN → REVIEW → VERIFY

statement.title:
A complete record
of work.
statement.description: A task should be more than an answer. It should have a plan, bounded actions, a reviewable change set, and an honest verification result.

loop.title:
From a request
to evidence.
loop.description: Follow the agent’s work without losing the right to decide what happens next.

run.request: Prepare the onboarding view for a first project.

understand.main: Reading project conventions, workspace files, session context, and available tools.

plan.main: Turning a request into a sequence of reviewable steps before any file is changed.

act.main: Applying the accepted change set and retaining each tool call with its project evidence.

verify.main: Showing the actual checks that ran, the outcome they produced, and anything that still needs attention.
code: change set / ready for your review

control.title:
Move fast.
Stay informed.
control.description: Daedalus separates reading, proposing, writing, and destructive actions. You see the intent, inspect the evidence, then decide how far an agent can go.

points.risk: Tool policies match the action’s risk
points.evidence: Diffs and terminal output stay with the run
points.restart: Interrupted workflows restart from safe evidence

context.title:
Work with the project,
not around it.

codebases.title: Codebases
codebases.description: Files, Git history, diagnostics, terminals, and team instructions in one working context.

tools.title: Connected tools
tools.description: MCP servers and Skills extend an agent without slipping past its review and approval boundaries.

godot.title: Godot, deeply
godot.description: When the project is a game, go beyond code: scenes, resources, editor patches, and headless checks.

models.title: Choose the model for the job.
models.description: Use built-in providers or compatible OpenAI, Responses, and Anthropic endpoints.

mcp.title: Connect the capabilities you need.
mcp.description: Keep external tools visible and governed by the same policy layer.

skills.title: Teach a repeatable way of working.
skills.description: Give agents project-specific instructions and focused operating knowledge.

workspace.title: Keep the work in reach.
workspace.description: Persistent sessions, panels, terminal tabs, and results—ready when you return.

trust.title:
Autonomy needs
boundaries.
trust.description: Daedalus is designed around a simple premise: an agent can be capable without becoming opaque.

boundaries.title: Local workspace boundaries
boundaries.description: Actions resolve inside an allowed project scope.

approval.title: Explicit approval gates
approval.description: Writing, commands, and external actions stay deliberate.

evidence.title: Persistent evidence
evidence.description: Plans, changes, output, warnings, and verification remain inspectable.

secrets.title: Secrets kept out of ordinary config
secrets.description: Provider credentials and integration secrets are not ordinary project data.

closing.title:
Make the change.
Know the result.
closing.description: For projects that need more than a generated answer.

meta.title: Daedalus Studio — 做出改变，保持掌控
meta.description: Daedalus Studio 是一个让 Agent 理解上下文、采取行动并证明结果的工作台。

hero.title:
做出改变。
保持掌控。
hero.description: Daedalus Studio 是一个让 Agent 理解上下文、采取行动并证明结果的工作台。
hero.caption: 描述 → 计划 → 审查 → 验证

statement.title:
一份完整的
工作记录。
statement.description: 一项任务不该只得到一个回答。它应包含计划、有边界的行动、可审查的改动集，以及诚实呈现的验证结果。

loop.title:
从一个请求
到一组证据。
loop.description: 跟随 Agent 的工作过程，同时始终保留决定下一步的权利。

run.request: 为第一个项目准备新手引导视图。

understand.main: 正在读取项目约定、工作区文件、会话上下文和可用工具。
code: 工作区 / 已索引 18 个文件
说明文件 / 已应用 AGENTS.md
工具 / 12 个工具符合当前策略

plan.main: 先将请求拆解为一系列可审查步骤，再对任何文件做出改动。
code: 计划 / 检查新手引导路由
提议 / 创建工作区选择器
验证 / 运行针对性检查

act.main: 应用已接受的改动集，并为每次工具调用保留项目证据。

verify.main: 展示实际运行的检查、它们产生的结果，以及仍需关注的内容。
code: 针对性测试 / 已通过
改动集 / 等待你的审查

controlVisual.approvalTitle:

再应用

control.title:
快速推进。
始终知情。
control.description: Daedalus 将读取、提议、写入和破坏性操作分开处理。你能看到意图、检查证据，再决定 Agent 可以走多远。

points.risk: 工具策略与操作风险相匹配
points.evidence: 差异与终端输出始终留在本次运行中
points.restart: 中断的工作流可从安全证据重新开始

context.title:
与项目一起工作，
而不是绕过项目。

codebases.title: 代码库
codebases.description: 将文件、Git 历史、诊断、终端与团队约定纳入同一个工作上下文。

tools.title: 已连接的工具
tools.description: MCP Server 与 Skills 可以扩展 Agent，同时不绕过审查和审批边界。

godot.title: 深入 Godot
godot.description: 当项目是一款游戏时，能力不止于代码：还能处理场景、资源、编辑器 Patch 与无头检查。

depth.title:
带上你自己的
智能能力。

models.title: 为任务选择合适的模型。
models.description: 可使用内置供应商，也可接入兼容 OpenAI、Responses 和 Anthropic 的端点。

mcp.title: 连接你需要的能力。
mcp.description: 让外部工具保持可见，并接受同一套策略层的治理。

skills.title: 教会 Agent 可重复的工作方式。
skills.description: 提供项目专属说明与聚焦的操作知识。

workspace.title: 让工作始终触手可及。
workspace.description: 持久化会话、面板、终端标签与结果，在你回来时继续等待。

trust.title:
自主性需要
边界。
trust.description: Daedalus 围绕一个简单前提设计：Agent 可以强大，但不该变得不透明。

boundaries.title: 本地工作区边界
boundaries.description: 操作只会在允许的项目范围内解析。

approval.title: 明确的审批关卡

evidence.title: 持久的证据

closing.title:
做出改变。
知晓结果。
closing.description: 献给那些需要的不只是一次生成式回答的项目。
